name: Vengeful Heart
source:
Set long after humanity has polluted this planet, groundwater has become undrinkable and seeing a living plant is considered a luxury. Most people live in megacities that rely on the labor of poor masses to sustain a modern standard of living for the few at the top. With most of the earth scorched, water is regarded as liquid gold and the control of it is the truest form of power. Forced to cope with a permanent water shortage, ordinary people persist and toil on the hope that if they work hard enough, they too can someday swim every morning in the refreshing pools of the Gardens.

We follow the story of Josephine Lace, a young hydraulic engineer eager to climb the corporate ladder and claim a spot at the top. Until the day when that promising future is ripped away from her, leaving her half-dead and homeless, she becomes hellbent on taking down the system that ruined her and left her without a heart. Along the way she meets a diverse group of people sympathetic to her cause, every one with secrets of their own. With their help, she seeks redemption, love and most of all vengeance.

[From [url=https://salmon-snake.itch.io/vengeful-heart-full-game]Itchio[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在一個人類汙染地球很久之後的時代。地下水已經無法飲用，看見活著的植物被視為奢侈。大多數人居住在巨型城市裡，依靠貧困大眾的勞動，維持頂層少數人的現代生活標準。地球大部分土地已經焦黑，水被視為液態黃金；控制水資源，就是最真實的權力。普通人被迫應對永久的缺水危機，仍堅持勞作，希望只要足夠努力，終有一天也能每天早晨在花園的清涼泳池裡游泳。

我們將跟隨約瑟芬．蕾絲的故事。她是一名年輕的水利工程師，渴望在公司裡一路升遷，躋身頂層。直到那個充滿希望的未來被徹底奪走，她身受重傷、無家可歸，也因此下定決心摧毀那個毀掉她、讓她失去心靈的制度。旅途中，她遇見一群支持她事業、背景各異的人，而每個人都有自己的秘密。在他們幫助下，她追尋救贖、愛情，最重要的是復仇。
